meta.about: Figures for the static SSC-JE question bank (js/ssc-je-*.js), which predates inline `f` fields and is too large to rewrite in place. Keyed by a 32-bit FNV-1a hash of the lowercased, whitespace-collapsed question text; each entry also stores the first 120 chars of that normalized text, and js/ssc-je-training.js only trusts a figure when the stored prefix matches the live question — so a hash collision can never display the wrong diagram. SVGs are drawn by the site's CI agent (scripts/site-agent.js, agent BankFigures) and pass cleanFigSvg server-side plus js/fig-svg.js client-side; figures that fail any gate never ship. A missing file simply means no figures.
